more_info.overview: Glucose oxidase is an enzyme that oxidises glucose using oxygen and produces glucono-delta-lactone and hydrogen peroxide. It occurs in several biological sources, including certain fungi. Its biochemical reaction is distinct from simply adding a small-molecule antioxidant. Food-processing activity depends on the availability of glucose and oxygen and on the particular enzyme preparation. The general identity source does not establish one commercial production strain or a typical current finished-food example.
